_comment: Coverage floor for CI. These are the measured values, not targets: a pull request that lowers them fails. Raise them deliberately, never by accident.
_scope: The frontend numbers include every source file (Vitest 5 counts never-imported files as uncovered). The backend number covers app/ and qatta/.
_history: The frontend floor moved from 80.89 to 66.35 in v0.1.1: the coverage provider changed scope (all files, not only the imported ones). The number is stricter, not worse.
